name: 📊 Seguimiento de Carritos Abandonados (3 Horas Laborables)

parameters.query:
SELECT 
  co.id,
  co.guest_name,
  co.guest_email,
  co.guest_phone,
  co.total_amount,
  co.order_data,
  co.created_at,
  co.updated_at,
  co.cart_age_days,
  co.abandoned_whatsapp_sent,
  co.abandoned_reminder_sent,
  -- Calcular edad en horas laborables
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - co.created_at)) / 3600 as horas_inactivo,
  -- Validar que tenga datos registrados
  co.guest_email IS NOT NULL AND co.guest_email != '' as tiene_email,
  co.guest_phone IS NOT NULL AND co.guest_phone != '' AND co.guest_phone LIKE '57%' as tiene_telefono,
  -- Calcular si cumple 3 horas laborables
  EXTRACT(DOW FROM co.created_at) NOT IN (0,6) as es_dia_laborable,
  -- Horas laborables calculadas
  CASE 
    WHEN EXTRACT(DOW FROM co.created_at) NOT IN (0,6) THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - co.created_at)) / 3600
    ELSE 0 
  END as horas_laborables
FROM guest_orders co
WHERE co.status = 'carrito_creado'
  AND co.abandoned = true
  AND co.abandoned_whatsapp_sent = false
  AND co.abandoned_reminder_sent->>'whatsapp_3horas' IS NULL
  AND co.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
  -- Validar que el cliente tenga datos registrados
  AND co.guest_email IS NOT NULL
  AND co.guest_email != ''
  AND co.guest_phone IS NOT NULL
  AND co.guest_phone != ''
  AND co.guest_phone LIKE '57%'
  -- Que tenga 3 horas laborables
  AND horas_laborables >= 3
ORDER BY co.cart_age_days ASC,
  co.created_at ASC
LIMIT 20;
